title: CardioAssist AI — offline research model artifact descriptor (v1)
description: Structural description of a research model package for OFFLINE admission checks. This is an internal engineering descriptor, not an API contract and not an approval record. Admission is always RESEARCH_ONLY: no descriptor, checksum or model file can grant scientific, clinical or serving approval.
x-not-an-approval: A descriptor that passes every check is admitted to local research tooling only. Interpretation, calibration adequacy and clinical validity require separate human, scientific and clinical review.

descriptor_schema_version.description: Versioned descriptor format. A new format requires a new schema file and a new validator branch.

artifact_type.description: Serialization container only. The validator hashes bytes and never deserializes any of these formats.

artifact_ref.description: Relative path inside the caller-supplied artifact source root. Absolute paths, traversal and symlinks are rejected by the source, not by this pattern alone.

model_family.description: Model family. The exact allowlist of registered research families is enforced by the validator (unexpected_model_family), not duplicated here; registration is not an endorsement and not a serving commitment.

score_type.description: Declares how a score must be read. It must agree with the calibration status; it can never promote a margin to a probability.

calibration.description: Calibration declaration. 'separate_artifact' requires calibration_ref, calibration_sha256 and calibration_size_bytes; those bytes are read through the artifact source and hashed by the validator, so an arbitrary digest cannot qualify. 'embedded_in_verified_artifact' is admitted only as a non-independent claim: nothing inside the model container is opened and no separate calibration hash may be asserted. 'none' is required for the 'uncalibrated' and 'not_assessed' statuses.

calibration_ref.description: Relative path of a separate calibration artifact; null when calibration is not a separate verified file.

calibration_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the calibration bytes read from calibration_ref; null when there is no separately verified calibration artifact.

explainability.description: Declared explanation method and the truthful capability that backs it. Genuine TreeSHAP/LIME is not implemented or verified in this repository: the API returns deterministic SHAP-shaped synthetic fixture offsets only. A descriptor asserting 'implemented_and_verified_in_research_harness' is rejected because no such implementation exists.

feature_contract.description: The artifact's input contract, including its approved input order. Names, value types and units are cross-checked against the pinned shared feature schema, and each feature's position is checked against the reviewed order policy named by order_policy_id. The descriptor cannot introduce a private feature dictionary or infer an order from schema serialization.

feature_schema_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact shared/contracts/schemas file bytes.

order_policy_id.description: Identifier of the reviewed ordered feature binding this artifact was built against. Feature names must appear at exactly the positions that policy declares; schema serialization order is never used as an input order. An unregistered id is rejected.

target_definition_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact registered target definition text. Changing target semantics requires a new registered target id; editing this hash is rejected.

prediction_timepoint.description: Declared token for when the predictors are asserted to exist. Recorded for human review; the validator does not adjudicate its clinical correctness.

pooled_cohorts.description: Must be false. Pooling is not admitted by any current authorization.

research_label.description: The exact evidence label the artifact may carry. Internal exploratory output is never a validated or deployable model.

serving_status.description: APPROVED_FOR_SERVING exists only so that a self-declared serving claim is rejected explicitly instead of being ignored. This release has no independently approved serving status.
